name: kubectl describe events block
description: Per-resource events shown in `kubectl describe`. Most-useful section for triage. Format: Type Reason Age From Message. e.g. Warning FailedScheduling 30s default-scheduler 0/3 nodes available: insufficient memory.

name: Event resource
description: Cluster-wide log of significant changes. Defaults to events.k8s.io/v1 (newer) or v1 (legacy). TTL'd (default 1h). Visible via `kubectl get events`.

name: Event Type: Normal
description: Informational events: Created, Started, Pulled, Killing, Scheduled, SuccessfulCreate.

name: Event Type: Warning
description: Problem events: Failed, FailedScheduling, FailedMount, BackOff, Unhealthy, FailedKillPod. The triage focus.

name: Event Reason: FailedScheduling
description: Pod can't be scheduled. Message details fitness failure: 'insufficient cpu', 'didn't have free ports', 'node(s) had taint X', 'didn't match Pod's node affinity', 'persistentvolumeclaim X not found'.

name: Event Reason: FailedMount
description: Volume couldn't be mounted. PVC not bound, secret/configmap not found, NFS server unreachable, csi driver crashed.

name: Event Reason: Failed (image pull)
description: Image pull failed. Often combined with reason 'ErrImagePull' or 'ImagePullBackOff' on container.

name: Event Reason: BackOff
description: Container repeatedly crashing; kubelet backing off restart attempts.

name: Event Reason: Unhealthy
description: Probe failed. Message: 'Liveness probe failed: HTTP probe failed with statuscode: 503'.

name: Event Reason: FailedKillPod
description: Kubelet couldn't kill pod. Often runtime hung or container in D state.

name: kubectl debug command
description: Three modes: ephemeral container in existing pod, copy-pod-with-modifications, node-debug (privileged pod with hostPath rootfs).

name: Ephemeral container debug pattern
description: `kubectl debug -it pod/X --image=nicolaka/netshoot --target=app` adds netshoot container sharing PID+network namespace with 'app'. Inspect from inside without modifying pod spec.

name: Copy-pod debug pattern
description: `kubectl debug pod/X --copy-to=X-debug --container=app --image=busybox` clones the pod with image swapped on a container. Don't kill the original; experiment in copy.

name: Node debug pattern
description: `kubectl debug node/X -it --image=busybox` schedules a privileged pod on node with hostPath / mount. Then `chroot /host` to act as host root. Risky — avoids needing SSH.

name: crictl
description: CRI-direct CLI. Bypasses kubelet+API server. Talks straight to containerd/CRI-O via /run/containerd/containerd.sock. For node-level debug when API unavailable.

name: Kubelet logs
description: Per-node kubelet logs. systemd: `journalctl -u kubelet -f`. Verbose: --v=4. Source for: pod admission, runtime errors, volume mounts, garbage collection, eviction decisions.

name: API server logs
description: `kubectl logs -n kube-system kube-apiserver-NODE`. Audit log if enabled. Source for: auth failures, admission rejections, etcd errors.

name: Scheduler logs
description: `kubectl logs -n kube-system kube-scheduler-NODE`. Source for: why pods aren't scheduling. Verbose `--v=10` shows per-pod scheduling decisions.

name: Controller-manager logs
description: `kubectl logs -n kube-system kube-controller-manager-NODE`. Source for: deployment rollout decisions, garbage collection, node lifecycle.

name: etcd logs
description: `kubectl logs -n kube-system etcd-NODE`. Source for: storage errors, leader changes, slow operations (>100ms warnings).

name: Pod log rotation
description: Kubelet rotates per-container logs at /var/log/pods/<ns>_<pod>_<uid>/<container>/N.log. ContainerLogMaxSize, ContainerLogMaxFiles in kubelet config. Old rotated logs available via --previous in `kubectl logs`.

name: metrics-server
description: Cluster-internal monitoring source for `kubectl top`. Polls kubelet's resource-metrics endpoint (/metrics/resource). Required for HPA. NOT a long-term metrics store.

name: Resource Metrics API
description: metrics.k8s.io group. Aggregated API served by metrics-server. Provides PodMetrics, NodeMetrics. Consumers: kubectl top, HPA.

name: Custom Metrics API
description: custom.metrics.k8s.io. For HPA scaling on app-defined metrics (queue depth, etc.). Implementations: prometheus-adapter, KEDA.

name: External Metrics API
description: external.metrics.k8s.io. For metrics not associated with K8s objects (e.g. SQS queue length, GCP Pub/Sub backlog). KEDA implements.

name: K8s logging architecture
description: App writes to stdout/stderr → container runtime captures → kubelet exposes → /var/log/pods/ on node. Cluster-level: log shipper (Fluent Bit, Vector, Filebeat) DaemonSet → backend (Loki, ELK, Datadog).

name: kubectl events (modern)
description: 1.23+ replacement for `kubectl get events`. Better filtering, --for=TYPE/NAME scoping.

name: kubectl get events (legacy)
description: Standard event listing. --sort-by=.lastTimestamp for chrono. -A for cluster-wide.

name: kubectl top
description: Resource usage. Requires metrics-server. Pods or nodes scope. Sort by cpu/memory.

name: kubectl cluster-info
description: Quick check: control-plane reachable + addon endpoints. dump variant: full cluster state to dir for offline analysis.

name: kubectl cluster-info dump
description: Dump full cluster state (nodes, pods, events, services) to dir. For support tickets / postmortems. --output-directory=DIR.

name: must-gather (OpenShift) / sosreport
description: Bundled diagnostic collection. OpenShift: `oc adm must-gather`. K8s: cluster-info dump + per-distro tooling (KIND has its own).

name: Troubleshoot init containers
description: Init containers run sequentially. Pod stuck Initializing means an init container failed/hung. `kubectl logs POD -c <init-container-name>` (no --previous since they don't restart in default policy).

name: Debug Services workflow
description: K8s docs canonical Service-debug procedure: confirm Service exists, has endpoints, kube-proxy programmed iptables, network reachable from a debug pod. Each step: a kubectl command.

name: Debug Running Pods workflow
description: K8s docs procedure: get pod status, describe events, logs (current + --previous), exec for in-pod inspection, ephemeral debug container if needed.

name: Pod stuck Terminating
description: Pod won't disappear. Usually finalizer or volume detach failure. Diagnose: `kubectl get pod X -o yaml` look at finalizers + deletionTimestamp + status. Force: `--grace-period=0 --force` (last resort).

name: Pod stuck Pending
description: Schedulable causes (FailedScheduling event), volume binding failure, init-container failure, image-pull-back-off. `kubectl describe` events tell you which.

name: CrashLoopBackOff debug pattern
description: Container crashing+restarting. Sequence: `kubectl logs POD --previous` (last instance's logs), `kubectl describe POD` (events + restart count), exec into a sleeping copy via kubectl debug --copy-to.

name: OOMKilled debug pattern
description: Memory exceeded. `kubectl describe pod` shows reason: OOMKilled, exit 137. Diagnose: actual memory use via `kubectl top pod` (live) or container memory.events from cgroup. Fix: raise limits or fix leak.

name: ImagePullBackOff debug pattern
description: Image can't be pulled. Causes: typo in image name, missing imagePullSecrets, registry rate limit, registry auth expired, private registry network unreachable. Events show registry response.

name: DNS resolution debug
description: Run `nslookup` from a debug pod with same DNS config as failing pod. Check /etc/resolv.conf. Verify CoreDNS pods running and Service `kube-dns` has endpoints. Test cluster.local + external resolution.

name: API server throttling
description: kube-apiserver responds 429 (Too Many Requests) when client exceeds rate limit (Priority+Fairness). Visible in client logs. Increase priority class or batch requests.

name: etcd slow watch
description: etcd warnings: 'apply request took too long'. Caused by disk latency, large objects, watch cache miss. Look at etcd_disk_wal_fsync_duration_seconds metric.

name: CSI driver debug
description: Volume mount issues: check csi driver pods (DaemonSet) running, `kubectl describe pvc` for binding, `journalctl -u kubelet` on the node for mount logs.

name: Prometheus + Grafana (cross-ref)
description: Standard observability stack. ServiceMonitor/PodMonitor CRDs (prometheus-operator) for scrape config. Out of this corpus's scope.

name: pprof profiling
description: Go components (apiserver, kubelet, controller-manager, scheduler) expose pprof at /debug/pprof. `go tool pprof http://NODE:10250/debug/pprof/profile`. Restricted by RBAC.

name: Audit logging
description: kube-apiserver --audit-policy-file. Records every API request: who, what, when, response. Levels: None, Metadata, Request, RequestResponse. Crucial for security forensics.

name: Kubernetes Dashboard
description: Web UI. Useful for visualizing resource state, but `kubectl describe` covers same info faster. Auth: token + RBAC.

name: Lens / k9s (clients)
description: Third-party kubectl frontends. Lens = GUI; k9s = TUI. Productivity-boosters; same auth/authz as kubectl.

name: kubectl debug --profile=netadmin
description: Pre-defined profile granting CAP_NET_ADMIN, CAP_NET_RAW for network debugging. Combined with image=netshoot.

name: kubectl debug --profile=sysadmin
description: Profile with CAP_SYS_ADMIN + privileged for system-level debug. Use sparingly.

name: Events vs Conditions
description: Events = transient log of changes (TTL'd). Conditions = current status fields (PodScheduled, Initialized, Ready). Both useful — conditions for live state; events for history.

name: kubeadm troubleshoot
description: For self-managed clusters: `kubeadm init/join phase ... --dry-run`, kubelet logs (journalctl -u kubelet), kubelet config /var/lib/kubelet/config.yaml.

name: Component debug procedure
description: For control-plane issues: SSH to node → check kubelet → check container runtime (crictl ps) → check static pod manifests at /etc/kubernetes/manifests/.
